mentions.title: spun a bearing....whats it look like?
mentions.snippet: Generic spun-bearing diagnosis thread, but contains a report of rod bearings spun twice in three months on a boosted setup running King bearings. Single poster, boosted application, plausibly a lubrication or clearance cause rather than a product defect.

mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread. 2024-production King main bearings called out as out of spec on free spread, with an engineer advising builders not to use them and to return them; poster says similar issues appeared in 2025 production runs too.

mentions.title: King Main Bearings Defective
mentions.snippet: Multiple sets of King STDX undersize thrust bearings reported over 1mm too narrow to fit BMW S85 and S65 blocks, reproduced across several different blocks. Dimensional defect spanning more than one set.
mentions.replyNote: Still 307-redirects to the tollbit.m5board.com mirror instead of returning thread content; redirect not followed.

mentions.title: King main and rod bearings marked STDX
mentions.snippet: A 2024 King main bearing confirmed out of spec by King's own technical support, with the poster raising concern that recent production runs may have a manufacturing process problem.
mentions.replyNote: Thread read successfully; no King or official brand representative has replied, and it remains open and unresolved.

mentions.title: King Bearing - lack of professional help for quality control problem
mentions.snippet: Customer received an unopened King XP package with the wrong bearing quantities and sizes mixed in, and complains about the lack of professional support in getting the quality-control problem resolved. Product fault plus service complaint.

mentions.title: King Bearing Failures?
mentions.snippet: Thread on King main and rod bearings severely damaged during startup and break-in, requiring crank rework. Other posters suggest contributing factors beyond the bearings themselves.
